title: Crash when entering playmode
body:
### Tested versions

Can be done in godot 4.7 dev.
Not sure what other versions this bug effects.

### System information

Windows 11 godot 4.7 dev, Vulkan with Forward+ and an NVIDIA RTX 3060. 16 gigabytes of ram, and a Intel I5 CPU with no integrated  GPU.

(NOTE! this is part of the logs I think are important to the crash.) And another thing to note is that the crash got worse every time i tried again. It even made my display go black and freeze my desktop!

### Steps to reproduce

1. open a project
2. press the play button
3. See a stream of errors in the console (in your terminal window/godot console if launched from the godot  console EXE)
4. See as the editor freezes then unfreezes as the game process is automatically killed.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I unfortunately do not have a MRP.
(EDIT: something I forgot to mention. the RTX 3060 mentioned at the top of this issue is a RTX 3060 MSI editon. and is not a standard RTX 3060.)
